item.title: Rethinking imitation learning with Predictive Inverse Dynamics Models
item.description:
Author: Pallavi Choudhury, Lukas Schäfer, Chris Lovett, Katja Hofmann, Sergio Valcarcel Macua
Date: February 05, 2026
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Machine Learning", "Imitation Learning", "Robotics", "Predictive Modeling"]
Summary:
  • Imitation learning teaches AI agents by following human demonstrations.
  • Traditional behavior cloning maps current states directly to expert actions.
  • Predictive Inverse Dynamics Models split this process into two distinct steps.
  • These models first predict a future state before choosing an action.
  • This approach significantly reduces ambiguity during the learning process.
  • PIDMs can achieve high performance with far fewer demonstrations than traditional methods.
